records.name: The Assistance Fund - IgG4-Related Disease Program
National Organization for Rare Disorders (NORD) Patient Assistance Programs

evidence.claim: The Assistance Fund opened a new program for Immunoglobulin G4-Related Disease providing financial assistance for copayments, health insurance premiums, and incidental medical expenses

NORD has provided assistance programs since 1987 including medication, financial assistance with insurance premiums and co-pays, diagnostic testing assistance, and travel assistance for clinical trials or consultation with disease specialists
